evidence.title: Canada suspends trade negotiations with USA and match tariffs dollar for dollar
Canada will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down

summary: Canada has halted trade negotiations with the United States and announced retaliatory tariffs matching U.S. measures. The move escalates tensions amid ongoing trade disputes between the two nations.
title: Canada Suspends Trade Talks with U.S., Matches Tariffs Dollar-for-Dollar
